tagline.en: Phoenix to the pines, a stagecoach road made freeway
tagline.zh: 从凤凰城到松林，由驿马道升级而成的高速

mileageSource: FHWA Route Log and Finder List, Table 1, January 2026

start.zh: 亚利桑那州凤凰城，与 I-10 相接

end.zh: 亚利桑那州弗拉格斯塔夫，与 I-40 相接

en: I-17 is Arizona's north–south spine and it never leaves the state. It starts in the saguaro desert at Phoenix, crosses the Agua Fria drainage, climbs out of Black Canyon City onto the mesa in a series of steep curves, passes Cordes Junction where State Route 69 peels off for Prescott, drops into the Verde Valley past Montezuma Castle, and finishes in the ponderosa pine at Flagstaff on the southern rim of the Colorado Plateau.

The transition is abrupt enough that the road is effectively two highways. The southern half is a desert commuter freeway; the northern half is a mountain grade with runaway-truck geometry, snow closures in winter, and a rest area at Sunset Point that exists largely because of the view and the climb.

Its traffic is unusual for an Interstate in that it peaks at weekends rather than on weekday mornings. Phoenix empties towards the high country on Fridays and Saturdays and returns on Sundays, which is why Arizona built its first reversible lanes here rather than in a city.
zh: I-17 是亚利桑那州的南北主干，且从不越出州界。它自凤凰城的巨柱仙人掌荒漠起步，穿过阿瓜弗里亚水系，以一连串陡弯从黑峡谷城爬上台地，经过 SR 69 分岔前往普雷斯科特的科德斯枢纽，再下行进入韦尔德河谷、路过蒙特祖马城堡，最终止于科罗拉多高原南缘弗拉格斯塔夫的西黄松林中。
这种转变之突兀，使这条路实际上像两条公路。南半段是荒漠中的通勤高速；北半段则是山区坡道，设有失控卡车所需的线形，冬季因积雪封路，而日落点休息区的存在在很大程度上正是因为那里的景观与那段爬坡。
它的交通特征对一条州际公路而言很不寻常：高峰出现在周末，而非工作日清晨。凤凰城的居民在周五、周六涌向高地，周日返回——这也是亚利桑那把全州第一条可变方向车道建在这里、而非建在城市里的原因。

en: The corridor is old. A stagecoach line began running in 1878 from Cañon — today's Black Canyon City — up to Prescott, a jarring thirty-hour ride with steep climbs, dangerous crossings of the Agua Fria and the risk of robbery. Construction of a modern road on the Black Canyon alignment, as State Route 69, began in 1936 and was interrupted by the Depression and the Second World War.

After the war the highway was realigned out of the canyon and up onto the mesa, bypassing the old mining camps at Bumble Bee, and dedicated in December 1952; it was not fully paved until 1955. The Black Canyon Highway reached Prescott as SR 69 in May 1956, and the Verde leg from Cordes Junction through Camp Verde to Flagstaff was built as SR 79.

Phoenix's own freeway era began in 1950 with the Black Canyon Freeway, the state's first controlled-access highway, whose interchange at Grand Avenue was Arizona's first. When the Interstate programme arrived, Arizona resolved to designate SR 69, SR 79 and the Black Canyon Freeway as a single route. Work in earnest began in 1956 and finished in August 1978, when the last stretch from Copper Canyon to Montezuma Castle near Camp Verde opened to traffic.
zh: 这条走廊历史悠久。1878 年，一条驿马车线路开始从卡尼翁（即今日的黑峡谷城）通往普雷斯科特，全程颠簸三十小时，途中要爬陡坡、涉险渡阿瓜弗里亚河，还要冒被劫的风险。沿黑峡谷线位修筑现代公路（即 SR 69）的工程始于 1936 年，随后被大萧条和第二次世界大战打断。
战后，公路线位被从峡谷内改到台地之上，绕开了邦布尔比一带的旧矿营，并于 1952 年 12 月举行通车典礼；直到 1955 年才全线铺装。黑峡谷公路以 SR 69 的名义于 1956 年 5 月通达普雷斯科特，而从科德斯枢纽经坎普韦尔德至弗拉格斯塔夫的韦尔德段则以 SR 79 建成。
凤凰城自身的高速公路时代始于 1950 年的黑峡谷高速公路——该州第一条封闭式控制出入道路，其大道街立交也是亚利桑那的第一座高速立交。州际公路计划启动后，亚利桑那决定将 SR 69、SR 79 与黑峡谷高速公路合并编为一条路线。实质性施工自 1956 年开始，至 1978 年 8 月竣工：最后一段从铜峡谷到坎普韦尔德附近的蒙特祖马城堡通车。

en: The 23 miles between Anthem Way and Sunset Point are the corridor's problem. Traffic on the stretch from Anthem to Cordes Junction rises by roughly half at weekends, and Arizona DOT identifies the southbound lanes between Sunset Point and Anthem as where the most troublesome crashes occur — a single incident on a two-lane mountain grade with no alternative route can stall traffic for hours.

The fix, begun in September 2022, added a third lane in each direction over the northern 15 miles and built a physically separated two-lane roadway alongside the southbound carriageway for the steep, winding eight miles from Black Canyon City up to Sunset Point. These flex lanes carry one direction at a time — normally northbound on weekdays and Saturdays, southbound on Sundays — and can be reversed for incidents. They are the first of their kind in Arizona.

Getting the alignment through the rock required controlled blasting between December 2022 and May 2024, with full closures of I-17 in both directions during each blast. The excavated material was crushed and reused in the new roadway rather than hauled off site.
zh: 安瑟姆道至日落点之间的 23 英里是这条走廊的症结所在。从安瑟姆到科德斯枢纽的路段周末车流量上升约五成，而亚利桑那州交通部指出，最棘手的事故集中在日落点至安瑟姆之间的南行车道——在一条没有替代路线的双车道山区坡道上，一起事故就足以让交通停滞数小时。
补救工程于 2022 年 9 月动工，在北段 15 英里内双向各增设一条车道，并沿南行主线一侧、在黑峡谷城至日落点这陡峭蜿蜒的八英里间另建一条与主线物理隔离的双车道。这些可变方向车道每次只承担一个方向的车流——通常工作日与周六向北、周日向南——并可在发生事故时反向使用。它们是亚利桑那首例。
为了在岩体中开辟线位，工程于 2022 年 12 月至 2024 年 5 月间实施了控制爆破，每次爆破都需双向全封闭 I-17。开挖料经破碎后重新用于新路基，而非外运弃置。

value.en: $186.7 million, all in Arizona. State and federal funds combined, in dollars of the day, as tabulated by FHWA at the close of the Interstate Construction programme; it excludes reconstruction after 1989.
value.zh: 1.867 亿美元，全部在亚利桑那。州与联邦资金合计，按当年美元计，为联邦公路管理局在州际建设计划收尾时的统计口径；不含 1989 年以后的改建。

figures.source: FHWA, Interstate System engineering data, Part III – Cost: estimated cost of individual Interstate routes, 1991 Interstate Cost Estimate (data as of 31 December 1989)

value.en: The Phoenix chapter of the American Association of Engineers priced the Black Canyon route at $3.76 million for 98 miles from Phoenix to Cottonwood, against $6.36 million for 110 miles by way of the Verde River. The cheaper, shorter option was preferred and became this road
value.zh: 美国工程师协会凤凰城分会测算：黑峡谷线位自凤凰城至科顿伍德全长 98 英里，造价 376 万美元；经韦尔德河的线位全长 110 英里，造价 636 万美元。更短更省的方案获采纳，即成为今日这条路

figures.source: Arizona DOT, "How the I-17 Black Canyon Freeway evolved from stage route to modern highway", 2018

timeline.en: A stagecoach line begins running from Cañon, now Black Canyon City, to Prescott — a thirty-hour journey.
timeline.zh: 驿马车线路开始从卡尼翁（今黑峡谷城）通往普雷斯科特，全程三十小时。

timeline.en: Construction starts on State Route 69 along the Black Canyon alignment; the Depression and the war halt it.
timeline.zh: 沿黑峡谷线位的 SR 69 动工，随后因大萧条与战争停工。

timeline.en: The realigned Black Canyon Highway, lifted out of the canyon onto the mesa, is dedicated in December.
timeline.zh: 改线后自峡谷移上台地的黑峡谷公路于 12 月举行通车典礼。

timeline.en: The Black Canyon Highway is completed as SR 69 to Prescott in May; construction of what becomes I-17 begins in earnest.
timeline.zh: 黑峡谷公路于 5 月以 SR 69 建成通达普雷斯科特；日后成为 I-17 的工程开始实质推进。

timeline.en: The Verde leg from Cordes Junction to Flagstaff, State Route 79, is finished; ADOT accounts date it to 1960 and to September 1961.
timeline.zh: 从科德斯枢纽至弗拉格斯塔夫的韦尔德段（SR 79）建成；亚利桑那州交通部的记述分别给出 1960 年与 1961 年 9 月两个时间。

timeline.en: A dedication ceremony for a section of I-17 in Phoenix is held on 10 November.
timeline.zh: 11 月 10 日，凤凰城 I-17 一段举行通车典礼。

timeline.en: The final 5.4 miles near Camp Verde open in August, completing the route.
timeline.zh: 坎普韦尔德附近最后 5.4 英里于 8 月通车，全线贯通。

timeline.en: Construction begins in September on the widening and flex lanes between Anthem Way and Sunset Point.
timeline.zh: 9 月，安瑟姆道至日落点的加宽与可变方向车道工程动工。

timeline.en: The new third lanes open in May and the flex lanes — Arizona's first — begin operating seven days a week in September.
timeline.zh: 新增第三车道于 5 月开放；亚利桑那首条可变方向车道于 9 月起全周运行。
